updates.content:
Title: Admins' may see delays in Copilot usage report data in a Microsoft 365 admin center

User impact: Admins' may see delays in Copilot usage report data in a Microsoft 365 admin center.

Current status: We determined that a component utilized in the flow of this functionality was deprecated, resulting in impact. We're reinstating this component and anticipate that this process should be complete by our next scheduled update.

Scope of impact: This event impacts any admin attempting to access Copilot usage report data in a Microsoft 365 admin center. This information may be updated as our investigation continues.

Start time: Monday, August 31, 2026, at 4:00 PM UTC

Root cause: A component utilized in the flow of this functionality was deprecated, resulting in impact.

Next update by: Tuesday, September 1, 2026, at 6:00 PM UTC
